posts.title: Heavy Sigh
posts.description: A sigh. An eye roll. A shift in posture. Leaders may not notice these reactions, but the people around them do. Steven Morris explores how our unconscious behaviors shape what others feel comfortable sharing—and what they choose to withhold. The post Heavy Sigh appeared first on Matterco.co .

posts.title: The Echo Tax
posts.description: AI promises greater efficiency, but what happens when we remove the friction that helps us think, grow, and lead? Steven Morris explores the hidden cost of technological acceleration and why investing in human development matters as much as investing in AI. The post The Echo Tax appeared first on Matterco.co .

posts.title: Who’s Doing the Listening?
posts.description: Who is really listening when someone speaks? Steven Morris explores how our habits, strengths, and unconscious responses shape the way we listen—and why greater self-awareness can transform leadership, conversations, and decision-making. The post Who’s Doing the Listening? appeared first on Matterco.co .
